_help: The East Orion Company (EOC): who runs it and which systems it owns. Starling reads this when you ask about the company ('tell me about the East Orion Company', 'who is the CEO', 'which systems does the EOC own', 'tell me about Arcadia'). Edit freely; she picks up changes next time she starts. 'ceo' = Commander names (spelled as in the game, capitals do not matter) that she treats as the CEO. 'pilots' = other company Commanders she should recognise, e.g. {"name": "Some Name", "role": "Captain"} (a list can be added here later). Each system: title (what she calls it), system (the game's name), say (optional: how to pronounce the system, otherwise she spells out the code), architect (who built it), aliases (other things you might call it, lower case), blurb (what she says; use || for a short pause), stations (name + services).

systems.title: Danforth
systems.blurb: This is where it all began. Home of the company, and home of the CEO. || Danforth Horizons has a market, and so does EOC Anchorage.

systems.title: Arcadia
systems.blurb: Arcadia Gateway has Interstellar Factors and a Human Technology Broker. || Very handy when you've been naughty.

stations.name: Arcadia Gateway
stations.services: Interstellar Factors and Human Technology Broker

systems.title: Black Legacy
systems.blurb: Black Legacy has lawyers, and a technology broker. || Everything a growing company needs.

systems.title: Baskerville Ring
systems.blurb: Baskerville Ring has lawyers. || There are also several haz res sites of various difficulty, so bring a ship you don't love too much.

systems.title: Payden's Haven
systems.blurb: The EOC Pensioner Retreat is a Coriolis, where you can put your feet up. || Siemens Gateway is a dodec, and a good place to buy a local exploration ship. || It's eighteen hundred and forty light years from Danforth, and an excellent area for first footfall exploration.

systems.title: Winter Station
systems.blurb: Winter Station sells C M M composites. || It sits directly below Feist's Progress.

systems.title: Rhino Heaven
systems.blurb: Rhino heaven. || I'm told that is a complete description.

systems.blurb: Milliways, the restaurant at the end of the universe, or at least at the end of a long jump.
